summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_049 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, emits the full congruence-intake routing surface with canonical diligence packs, dynamic intake questions, operational bounding and local-evidence binding registers, and preserves promotion discipline instead of overstating evidence sufficiency.

findings: The implementation accepts the declared upstream target-definition, facility-prior, asset-field and local-source inputs, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before delegating to the runtime adapter.

The adapter emits the contractually expected outputs: selected_asset_family, research_mode, evidence_mode_state, operational_intake_pack, operational_bounding_scorecard, dynamic_intake_question_register, local_evidence_binding_register, gap taxonomy, source conflict, entity resolution and promotion blocker surfaces.

Executable coverage confirms the key routing modes and pack-state behavior: public-only screening, hybrid diligence, operator-integrated congruence, canonical diligence-pack emission, partially evidenced pack states, dynamic-intake generation and local-binding upgrade behavior.

The implementation stays within boundary: it does not treat route hints as automatic closure, does not hide blockers to force promotion, and keeps unresolved evidence in explicit pack states, blocker registers and next-best-search surfaces.

The operational_intake_pack preserves a structured case_fingerprint, diligence_pack_register, diligence_pack_state_summary, search and escalation registers, dynamic intake surfaces and the embedded operational_bounding_scorecard aligned with the technical schema.

Each diligence-pack row carries stable explanatory fields including pack_name, current_state, decision_relevance, expected_local_sources, present_source_families, binding_needed, family_specific_focus and allowed_without_local_binding.

The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check produced a manufacturing hybrid-diligence case with research_mode=hybrid_diligence, partially_evidenced_pack_count=5, next_promotable_mode=operator_integrated_congruence, local binding claims including industrial_process_duty and dynamic intake questions spanning process, maintenance and metering boundaries.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered canonical pack emission, hybrid and operator-integrated mode transitions, intake schema behavior, dynamic-intake generation, operational bounding and local-evidence binding upgrade paths. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises the core congruence-intake routing, evidence-state and promotion-control surfaces described in test_spec.md and failure_modes_spec.md.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_asset_family_research_router.py, test_congruence_intake_schemas.py, test_dynamic_intake_generator.py, test_operational_bounding_scorecard.py and test_local_evidence_binding_upgrade.py with 16 passing tests. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using the documented manufacturing example shape and confirmed the wrapper returns the runtime adapter surface without local logic drift.
